questions.question: How does Pydantic guarantee structured output when bound to an LLM via `.with_structured_output(PydanticModel)`?
options: A) It crops the image output to fit a grid.
B) It passes the model schema via tool calling / JSON mode and validates the returned payload against Pydantic field types.
C) It forces the LLM to run on a local GPU.
D) It converts the Python class into a SQL table schema.
questions.explanation: `.with_structured_output()` leverages native tool-calling or JSON schema modes under the hood to ensure response compliance with the Pydantic class definition.

questions.question: What is the key advantage of using `@tool` decorators in LangChain tool calling?
options: A) It automatically executes tools without model consent.
B) It generates OpenAI/Gemini tool schemas from Python docstrings and type hints so models know when and how to call them.
C) It encrypts tool calls in memory.
D) It increases API rate limits.
questions.explanation: The `@tool` decorator inspects function signatures and docstrings to create standard tool definitions that LLMs can invoke.
